title: show: resolve concept names without .md, stay inside the bundle
summary: Specified: show accepts names without .md (exact file first, else name.md) and reads names from the bundle root, leading / or not (OKF 0.2); a directory is Concept not found; paths and symlinks leaving the bundle refused (exit 2). New requirement CORE-010; fix, 0.18.2. Issue 56.
